diagrams.title: Read-only production compatibility audit
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  Snapshot[Production Graph snapshot] --> Kernel[Proposed Ontology kernel]
  Kernel --> Residuals[Verified residual violations]
  Residuals --> NoGo[Activation remains No-Go]

clauses.statement: Only entity types and relation endpoint combinations verified in a complete read-only production snapshot are added as canonical or compatibility vocabulary; unknown endpoints are never inferred from relation names.

story_refs.text: Verified production vocabulary is classified and machine-readable

clauses.statement: belongs_to_project accepts only the verified production source types, remains many-to-many, and requires an existing project endpoint; orphan or non-project endpoints remain violations and cannot become inferred Decision scopes.

story_refs.text: Project membership compatibility removes false endpoint and cardinality violations

clauses.statement: Decision status active or decided is effective only with an outgoing owned_by edge to a person decider and an outgoing belongs_to_project edge to an existing project scope; entity-only validation cannot approve that aggregate, and inference uses the same declared effective status set.

story_refs.text: Decided Decisions are validated and inferred from canonical Graph edges

clauses.statement: Compatibility vocabulary never makes ownerless apps, orphan edges, unknown relations, or Decisions without verified authority and scope valid.

story_refs.text: Actual data defects remain explicit residuals

clauses.statement: The production shadow audit collects a complete snapshot inside a read-only transaction, evaluates the baseline and candidate against the same snapshot, records snapshot and observed-inventory digests plus baseline provenance, and reports unverified on incomplete collection instead of treating missing input as zero violations.

story_refs.text: Shadow audit records completeness and residual violations

clauses.statement: This compatibility release remains proposed with current null and null publication governance; activation requires separate evidence-backed repair, authority, signature, and publication work.
